name: tab-underline-strip
title: Tab Underline Strip
description: A tab bar displaying underlined selection border styles below active option.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Underline Tab Selection: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
